integrity: The proof is analytic and the packaged computation is a finite numerical replay of the exact published dispersion relation, not an independent derivation of the Floquet determinant.
limitations: Specific to the unit-edge half-flux model and coupling normalization of arXiv:2302.04601; no claim is made for other rational fluxes or the wide high-energy bands.
title: Renormalized half-flux band clusters for a preferred-orientation magnetic square quantum graph
